steps.content: The competition begins as scheduled the next day. Both of you arrive at the beach on time. Roulecca puts her hands on her hips as she confidently challenges you.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hmph! Before this game, I already tested things out with Lucy and Uncle John and Dummy and Gummy countless times. Whether it's chess, volleyball, darts, dice, or poker, Roulecca wins every time! Victory is mine!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: It's Roulecca's lucky day! There's no way I'm losing to you again!

steps.speaker: Four-leaf Clover Spectator
steps.content: You're the best! You're not gonna lose to him!
steps.female_content: You're the best! You're not gonna lose to her!

steps.content: It must've been tough for the four-leaf clovers. They had to let Roulecca continuously "win" without her noticing anything wrong. This family must've expended a lot of effort each time.
Unfortunately, without her lucky power to protect her here, the skinny little girl is no match for you.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Yeah, yeah. Roulecca, please spare me.
Hmph! You don't know who you're up against.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Let the game begin! Bring it on!
